pages.text: When the best choice depends on what others choose.

$(thing)Games and Strategy$(): the $(item)Strategy Table$() plays the Hawk-Dove game. Hawks fight for a prize V and risk an injury C; doves share, or back down from a hawk. With a share p of hawks, a hawk out-earns a dove by (V − pC)/2, so the population settles at p = V/C. Set the hawk share close enough, over enough rounds that luck cannot hide the gap (its noise falls as 1/√n), and the table records an $(item)Evolutionarily Stable Strategy$() ($(thing)Evolutionary Games$()). Its calibration: find the equilibrium in a table of payoffs.
The Bioreactor grows Tardigrade Cultures from half the genomes and moss with one, and without enzymes or sterile neutrinos. Biology (1.4) takes the game further, into selection and genetics.
